overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice needn't list open session when other topics were noticed, and omitting the property for a Purpose 6 executive session was justified by negotiating concerns.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's meeting notice was insufficiently specific because it did not list open session as a distinct topic.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the notice listed six topics besides the anticipated executive session, thus it was clear that an open session meeting would occur.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the notice for a Purpose 6 executive session on real estate failed to identify the property to be discussed.
